card.name: Last digit in confidence interval bounds
card.fires_on: A single digit (such as 7, 1 or 9) that ends the lower bound of a decimal number, typically inside a 95% CI range of study results, right before 'to' or a dash and the upper bound.

modes.label: Lower CI bound digit
modes.description: The final digit of the lower limit in a 95% confidence interval, just before the range separator.

modes.label: Digit in a number table
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal value in a table of numbers.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of the lower number in a confidence interval, such as the 7 in 1.27 to 1.48.
